name.zh: 月影展示东京毁灭的未来
name.en: Tsukikage Shows the Future Destruction of Tokyo

periods.summary: Tsukikage reveals Moon Heaven Jewel and shows a future memory of Tokyo burning in a world war. He explains that the three-way balance among the League, Union, and Rebellion may collapse when Rebellion's Tyrant dies, causing Rebellion remnants to flow toward Union and leading to World War III. His Akatsuki plan was an attempt to move Japan away from the doomed League side, but Ikki and Stella's fate-breaking growth convinces him to entrust the future to them instead.
periods.cause: Ikki refuses Tsukikage's support unless he explains his cooperation with Rebellion and creation of Akatsuki Academy.
periods.process: Tsukikage uses Moon Heaven Jewel to project a sensory vision of a devastated Tokyo. He explains the world power balance and the likely post-Tyrant scramble for Rebellion forces. He admits he tried to manipulate public opinion toward leaving the League by using Akatsuki's strength, but after Akatsuki's defeat and Ikki's awakening he sees a new path outside his vision.
periods.outcome: Tsukikage accepts the failure of his plan, sheds tears, and asks the younger generation to protect Japan and the world from the foretold future.
periods.significance: Explains the political motive behind the Akatsuki arc and sets up the looming global conflict involving Desperado powers.
